For a morning out and plans that follow, this women's pink blouse offers a regular fit. The woven fabric is 100% linen. The solid finish is easy to coordinate with the rest of your wardrobe.

It has a mandarin collar and half sleeves. There is an open front, along with a front pocket. The design finishes with a curved hem. Machine wash cold and wash dark colours separately. Do not bleach; remove promptly and dry in the shade.

Styling note - Wear it with navy trousers and flat shoes for a simple daytime combination. Switch to jeans and trainers when the plans are more casual, and leave an outer layer open to show the neckline. A small bag is enough to finish.

Product ID: l-blouse-11180-21556-pink

For a simple change from your usual daytime separates, this women's black blouse offers a regular fit. The woven fabric is 50% linen and 50% cotton. The solid finish is easy to coordinate with the rest of your wardrobe.

It has three-quarter sleeves. It features a half-open button placket. The design finishes with a straight hem. Machine wash cold and wash dark colours separately. Do not bleach; remove promptly and dry in the shade.

Styling note - Wear it with off-white trousers and loafers for an informal workday or lunch. For a day off, choose straight-leg jeans and trainers instead. Add an open jacket only when you need another layer, keeping the neckline visible.

Product ID: l-blouse-11440-21770-black
